አእመርኩ: አእመረ — I knew, I have come to know (1cs perfect, stem አእመረ 'know', root ʿ-m-r)
ወሀበኒ: ወሀበ — he gave me (3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
ይሁበከ: ወሀበ — he will give you (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, w-h-b + -ከ '2ms you')
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
ርእስየ: ርእስ — myself, my head (noun + -የ '1cs my'; በእንተ ርእስየ 'for myself')
ወየብሰ: የብስ — and dry land (ወ- + noun, accusative of place 'by land') · accusative object 'and dry land' (ወባሕረ ወየብሰ 'sea and dry land', as things made)
ወወሀበቶ: ወሀበ — and she gave him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
ወሰመየቶ: ሰመየ — and she named him (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ቶ)
ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
ብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — his wife (noun + -u 'his') · 'his wife' with the owner added after it (ብእሲቱ እኁሁ 'his wife, his brother's'; not the construct ብእሲተ)
ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
ትቤ: ብህለ — she said (3fs perfect ትቤ of the defective verb b-h-l)
ለወልድየ: ወልድ — to my son (ለ- + noun + -የ '1s my') · marking the object after አንግሥ-ኦ and ኣነግሦ ('make him king, my son')
ወሦዐ: ሠውዐ — and he sacrificed (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ś-w-ʿ; contracted spelling ሦዐ)
መሥዋዕተ: መሥዋዕት — offering, sacrifice (construct 'offering of') · also accusative 'a sacrifice' (ያዐርጉ መሥዋዕተ 'they offer a sacrifice')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
እፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — I desire, wish (1cs imperfect, G)
ኮኖ: ኮነ — it was to him, it became for him (3ms perfect, G, + -ኦ '3ms to him')
ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
ዘትቤ: ይቤ — what you said (ዘ- relative + 2ms ትቤ; the prefix forms of defective ይቤ serve as its perfect)
ቅድሜየ: ቅድመ — before me (preposition, stem ቅድሜ- + -የ '1s me')
ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel') · accusative in apposition to መንታ: ክልኤተ ሕዝበ 'two peoples' (the twins as heads of lines) (?) · or construct 'the two peoples of Perez and Zerah' (ክልኤተ ሕዝበ ፋሬስ ወዛራ) (?)
ወይነግሥ: ነግሠ — and he reigns (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, n-g-ś)
ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
ነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — kings (noun, plural ነገሥት, construct 'kings of')
ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
